description: Use when you know the apps and platforms a project uses (from its package.json, requirements, env variable names or config files such as vercel.json). For each platform Lode covers in the stack, returns the Lode records for the other apps on it, the platform plan each needs, objects more than one app writes, and the platform's published function run-time limits by plan, each with its source link and quote. Facts with links only, never a verdict on code; an app with no record means not documented. Set share to true only if the user agrees to Lode keeping the app and platform codes.

apps.description: Apps or SDK package names in the project, e.g. ["stripe","@supabase/supabase-js","resend"] (up to 40). Product names only

framework.description: One of: nextjs, react, remix, astro, sveltekit, nuxt, vue, angular, express, nestjs, django, flask, fastapi, rails, laravel, spring, dotnet, go, react-native, flutter, other

platforms.description: Platforms the project runs on or connects to, e.g. ["vercel","supabase"]

share.description: true only if the user agrees to Lode keeping the app and platform codes (default false)

name: check_stack
title: Check a project stack
